title: Dapper Man in Double-Breasted Suit, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a stylish man standing in a grassy yard wearing a sharp double-breasted suit, necktie, pocket square, and white shoes. In the background, lush bushes and a residential home are visible. His attire exemplifies quintessential mid-20th century American men's formal fashion, popular during the 1940s.
